answer: A Dedicated device bound by one-time code delivery with one identity per channel turns a private channel into public evidence: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the one-time code delivery is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. A quartz out of place triggers the check: the claim is frozen until its channel clears. When the dawn settles over the orchard, the binding holds because every channel answered its own challenge.
